fields.headline: Hospital status: operating with filtered air, visitors limited
fields.details: Air handlers on recirculate; visitors limited to one per patient; elective procedures continue; emergency department open.

fields.details: Tickets are refunded automatically. Vendors may collect stock from noon to 4 PM.

fields.headline: Clean-air shelter open today

fields.resources: Capacity 120; air handler filters upgraded this morning. Open 9 AM to 7 PM.
